tasks.title: Dimensional consistency rules between spec parameters
tasks.description: Identities and inequalities every correct measurement set must satisfy (length identity, L/R wheelbase, track fits body, arch clears tire...). Catches unit and code entry errors.
acceptance_criteria: Rules contain only relations, no vehicle values
Inputs with UNKNOWN status give NOT_EVALUATED, never PASS
A cm-for-mm entry, a 100 mm length typo and an arch below the tire radius are each reported FAIL
A FAIL blocks validation and therefore every checkpoint commit
